description: This source file defines the CosmosConditionNotSatisfiedException class, a custom exception used within the Orleans framework to indicate condition check failures in Cosmos DB storage operations. It extends InconsistentStateException and includes serialization support, multiple constructors, and properties for grain identification and collection details.
